description: Defines a template FactoryType class for creating and managing factory objects, including nested classes for factory instances and iteration, with licensing info and include guards.

classes.name: FactoryType
classes.description: A template class managing a collection of factory instances, supporting creation, destruction, and iteration over factories.

classes.name: FactoryType::Iterator
classes.description: Iterator class for traversing the factories within FactoryType.

classes.name: FactoryType::IFactory
classes.description: Interface for factory objects, providing methods to get elements and count created/queued elements.

classes.name: FactoryType::InternalFactoryType
classes.description: Implementation of IFactory, managing a pool of factory elements.

methods.name: DestroyFactories
methods.description: Deletes all factory instances managed by FactoryType.

methods.name: DestroyFactory
methods.description: Deletes a specific factory identified by an ID.

methods.name: CreateFactory
methods.description: Creates a new factory instance with a specified initial queue size.

methods.name: CreateFactory (overload)
methods.description: Creates a new factory with a specific identifier and initial queue size.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a proxy to a factory element by identifier.

methods.name: Element
methods.description: Returns a proxy to a factory element by identifier.

methods.name: Factories
methods.description: Returns an iterator over all factories.
